{{Quote|Were you just born yesterday? Or maybe your momma didn't tell you what a TIE Bomber is? We're in a war here! My Recon team has encountered unexpected numbers and can't take care of themselves right now. Now, are you going to keep jabbering or are you going to go save some men?|Captain Eso|<ref name="AED" />}}
'''Eso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who conducted combat activities out of a camp in the [[Val'Arnos Jungle]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
===Flanking the Empire===
{{Quote|What are you doing there looking slackjawed? We have a situation here that we can't afford to sit around with our thumbs up. Look, I need you to go flank a squad of 'troopers that have my men pinned down. Do you understand, or should I speak slower?|Captain Eso|<ref name="AED" />}}
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] by the name of Eso was alive during [[Time/Legends|time]] of the major [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], during which the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] won a decisive victory against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="AED" /> About [[0 ABY/Legends|6]] [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, the Rebel Alliance [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuated]] the [[Moon/Legends|moon]],<ref name="Doom Mission">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref> but Eso remained embroiled in combat against the Empire while stationed out of a camp in [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4's]] [[Val'Arnos Jungle]]. By that time, Eso held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Rebel Alliance and fought alongside several [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel commandos]], including a [[marine armor]]-clad [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] by the name of [[Yith Seenath]]. During his time at the camp, a recon team dispatched by Captain Eso found themselves pinned down by unexpected numbers of [[wetland assault stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="AED" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Fortunately for the battle-hardened [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], an individual loyal to the Rebel cause arrived to Eso's camp and agreed to help him save his men. Eso uploaded the location of known Imperial forces to the Rebel's [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], and recommended that a stealthy approach be utilized to quietly shoot the Imperials in the back of their [[Bone/Legends|skulls]]. While the operative did succeed in reaching the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of Imperials, the Rebel was detected by one of the swamptroopers. After shouting that they had been flanked, the rest of the squad opened fire on the Rebel combatant, eliminating any chance of a quick and quiet solution. However, the surprised Imperial forces were no match for the Rebel's superior combat ability, and were eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Lightfight|firefight]]. Although the recon team was rescued, Captain Eso derided the Rebel operative for what he perceived to have been a messy and reckless approach. Nonetheless, he ultimately commended the Rebel for completing the rescue operation successfully.<ref name="AED" />

===Destroying the Triage Unit===
[[File:RebelCommandoCampYavin.jpg|250px|thumb|The Rebel commando camp staffed by Captain Eso and Sergeant Yith Seenath]]
{{Quote|You're blasted right you'll help. It's not everyday you can get a clear shot at the throat of the Empire. Go out there and take out their medic. Got it?|Captain Eso|<ref name="AED" />}}
Thanks to the efforts of the rescued recon team, a hidden triage camp was discovered out in the dense jungle of Yavin 4. Eso remarked that because of Yavin 4's isolated nature, the Empire did not have the time to take their [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] to a fully operational [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]]. He remarked that out in the battlefield, [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] would simply throw on [[Bacta/Legends|bacta-soaked]] bandages and get back out into battle. To that end, Eso urged the Rebel operative to set out to the triage camp and kill the Empire's field [[Medic/Legends|medic]]. To Eso, medics were not to be seen as non-combat units, but rather active participants of war. The Rebel operative who had helped rescue the recon team was not soft to the realities of war, and agreed to carry out the captain's wishes. The Imperial triage camp was staffed by a single Imperial field medic and equipped with functioning [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]]. When the medic sighted the approaching Rebel operative, he shouted for his friends to save him. Out of the brush, a couple wetland assault stormtroopers emerged to open fire on the Rebel. However, their attempt to save the life of their field medic was in vain. Once again, the Rebel operative proved to be more formidable in combat, and all who defended the triage camp were killed. With the triage unit gone, Eso remarked that it would be easier to hunt down additional [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], and that the Empire might now be unable to come at them with full force.<ref name="AED" />

===An Infected Wound===
{{Quote|You know how an infected wound starts to rot and the medic says he's gotta cut it off or everything else will go? Well, that's what we have here... we've got a wound that's about to take out my body of men. I need you to be that medic, understand?''"<br />"''I've got a spine of steel, sir. I'll do what you need.''"<br />"''There's a kid who's seen too much fighting and he's about to snap. If he does at the wrong moment, my whole battalion could be wiped out. Go tell him, "Hey, look over there," and when his back is turned, do what you have to do. Report back only to me when you're done.|Captain Eso and the Rebel operative|<ref name="AED" />}}
Captain Eso was faced with the difficult responsibility of dealing with a young, shell-shocked Rebel soldier. Eso believed that the young kid had seen too much fighting and was about to snap. Eso likened this soldier to a rotting wound which endangered his entire body of men. He feared that if the disturbed soldier were to lash out at an inopportune time, it could result in his entire [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] being wiped out by Imperial forces. Eso recognized the sensitive nature of the situation, and asked the Rebel operative to help resolve it. The Rebel operative, who had already eliminated one the Empire's medics, was not the squeamish type. Eso instructed his operative to approach the young soldier, tell him, "Hey, look over there," and shoot him with his back turned.<ref name="AED" />

===Removing the Wound===
{{Quote|Mommy, can I go home now? Please? Mom? What are you doing with that blaster?|A shell-shocked Rebel trooper|<ref name="AED" />}}
The Rebel operative set out into the wilderness to locate the shell-shocked soldier, who was a trooper within the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. The operative eventually sighted the young man in the thick jungle calling out for his mother to bring him home. Although Eso had instructed the operative to use subtlety in executing the battle-wearied soldier, the maddened Rebel sighted Captain Eso's operative brandishing a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and asked what it was going to be used for. Before he could say anything more, the Rebel operative fulfilled Captain Eso's orders, and shot and killed the Rebel. When the operative returned to Eso to report the news, the Captain simply remarked that they both had [[Blood/Legends|blood]] on their [[Limb/Legends|hands]], but that the job needed to be done in order to save the rest.<ref name="AED" />

===Preparing for Evacuation===
{{Quote|Damn! The kid had already made enough noise to draw the Empire down on our position! AAARRG! If I hadn't gone soft, I would've done the job myself. Look, you have to help buy us time so the other men can get out of here!''"<br />"''What do you mean he made noise?''"<br />"''That damned crazed kid was out in the jungle calling out for his mommy! Well, those probe droids sure as all smack heard that and found where we were. Any more questions, or do you want to actually save some lives now?|Captain Eso and the Rebel operative|<ref name="AED" />}}
Unfortunately for Captain Eso, summarily executing the young soldier proved to be in vain. Prior to being killed, his cries out to his mother were recorded by Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]], allowing them to pin down their camp's location. With their whereabouts compromised, Captain Eso had no choice but to evacuate his fellow [[Commando/Legends|commandos]]. To help buy them some time, Eso ordered the Rebel operative to take out preliminary Imperial [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] seeking to confirm the camp's location. In order the save the lives of Captain Eso's battalion, the Rebel agreed to defeat as many incoming Imperial stormtroopers as possible. When the Imperial scout force sighted the Rebel operative, one of them remarked that they were in the right place, and to start by killing lone the Rebel. Despite facing overwhelming numbers in the face of the preliminary scout force, the Rebel had managed to kill a swath of stormtroopers.<ref name="AED" />

===Facing the Empire===
{{Quote|Okay, while you were taking those troopers out, I was able to pull a full evac of our soldiers. Now you get out of here, too. There should be a few hundred of the Empire coming in. I'll take care of them. Nice having you under my command, kid. Now go!|Captain Eso|<ref name="AED" />}}
Thanks to the Rebel operative's success in eliminating the preliminary scout force, Captain Eso managed to pull a full evacuation of his soldiers. However, the Empire still knew of their location, and was planning an offensive. Nonetheless, he curtly commended the Rebel operative who had aided him so loyally, and gave one final order to leave the camp for good. Even though Captain Eso believed that a few hundred Imperial troops were incoming, he was determined to stay behind to take care of them himself.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|It's done? Look&mdash;we've all got blood on our hands, got it? It's one of those things that you keep from your kiddies, but you'll know it needed to be done. Just remember that. It needed to be done to save the rest.|Captain Eso|<ref name="AED" />}}
Eso had [[Color/Legends|green]] scaly skin, and gold colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="AED" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|In case you weren't looking, we're in the middle of a jungle! The Empire doesn't have time to set up shop and fixing their 'troopers, kid! Out here you throw on some bacta-soaked bandages and get back out into battle.|Captain Eso|<ref name="AED" />}}
During his time in the Val'Arnos Jungle, he wore a gray formfitting [[Shirt|undershirt]] beneath a brown camouflage spec-ops duster. He also wore brown paramilitary camo pants and a dark colored [[Armor/Legends|helmet]]<ref name="AED" /> which resembled those commonly worn by Rebel forces during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], including [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|If you mean kill a non-combat unit, then do it yourself.''"<br />"''A non-combat unit!? You've got a guy out there who's patching up every one of the 'troopers who get away, and you call him a non-combat unit? The battlefield is no place to start getting soft!|Captain Eso's response to players who refuse to kill an Imperial field medic|<ref name="AED" />}}
Eso was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
